title: Field-aware invert of a prior RippleDeleteClips command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip RippleDeleteClips of a rightmost remnant restores only that command's delete write set when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later unrelated SetMarkers does not conflict: invert restores the deleted remnant and its cue and keeps the later markers and unmoved earlier cues. A later out-trim of the uninvolved left remnant, or a later text edit of the uninvolved left cue, also does not conflict.

A later leave-gap move of a remnant whose start was shifted by a ripple delete of an earlier remnant, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. Invert of a non-last ripple delete that must reinsert an earlier clip is not this slice's official success path; admission can refuse IMPLICIT_GAP because the restored item is appended after later remnants, and this slice does not change insertion order or retarget that code. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Leaf-level rational n/d granularity is unchanged. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered RippleDeleteClips, RippleTrimClip, leave-gap TrimClip, SplitClip, ExtractAudioClip, UnlinkAudioVideo / LinkAudioVideo, SetAudioTrackState, and SetTrackState locked/unlock semantics stay unchanged. A diverging unlink invert remains LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH.

A real UI path splits at 1s, adds left and right cues, ripple-deletes the right remnant, adds a later marker, inverts the RippleDeleteClips command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip. Extract is not required for this path.

Already-delivered ripple delete, ripple trim, leave-gap trim, split, extract, unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState / UnlinkAudioVideo / ExtractAudioClip / SplitClip / leave-gap TrimClip / RippleTrimClip, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, LiftClips/Cut, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND. An uncovering or cropping interval remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.
